description: This Java class `PrimaryKeyFinder` is part of the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically within the entity finder module. It provides functionality to locate entity values based on primary key conditions, utilizing a delegator for database interactions and supporting features like cache usage, dynamic field mapping, and selection of specific fields. The class processes XML element configurations to determine how to execute the primary key lookup.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyFinder
classes.description: A class that extends `Finder` to locate entity records based on primary key information, configurable via XML elements, supporting cache and field mapping options.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyFinder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the finder with XML element configuration, setting up field accessors, field maps, and select field expanders.

methods.name: runFind
methods.description: Executes the primary key lookup based on the provided context and delegator, respecting cache settings and auto field mapping options.

methods.name: runFind (static)
methods.description: Performs the core lookup logic for a given model entity and context, constructing primary key from context, converting fields, applying select options, and querying the database.
